lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْقَالِينَ is in the derivative form: قَالِين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ل/و-ي   q–l–w/y to dislike, to hate, to shun, to desert, to boycott; to roast; to toss about; to climb.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
قَلاَ qalā and قَالِين qālın.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَالِين qālın [pl. of act. part. قَالِى qālı] one who hates, loathes or detests

(26:168) إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِنَ الْقَالِينَ truly, I am one of those who detest what you do.

entries.label: قَلاَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَلاَ qalā ū [v. trans.] to come to shun, to come to dislike

(93:3) مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى your Lord has neither forsaken you [Prophet], nor [has He come to] hate [you].
